rows.grounds: object or topic denoting the energy center
second member of compound describing cakraṃ
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, possessing a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining attributes and status of the sixth chakra?
premises: The sixth chakra is identified in sequence.
It is described as royal or supreme among centers.
It is characterized as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth chakra is a preeminent eight-petaled center distinguished by the presence of a pericarp.
uncertainties: The specific referent of rājānam as a metaphorical or technical title is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the sixth chakra is the king, eight-petaled and with a pericarp.
